title: 보일러 조절기 읽기: 지금 몇 도, 몇 도로 해요?
objective: You can read the room temperature and the set temperature, and pick the right button for heating, hot water, away mode, and the timer.
summary: Learn to read the screen and buttons on a Korean wall boiler controller.
note: The screen on this sheet is an example. Your boiler controller may look a little different.

task.title: Read and use the controller
task.line: Use the screen, the button list, and the steps on page 1 to answer each question.

sections.heading: The screen: what you see on the wall
paragraphs: ● = on, ○ = off. This screen says: heating is on. The room is 20℃ now. You want 24℃.

sections.heading: Buttons and words on the controller

items.text: Turns the controller and boiler on or off.
Warms the floor and the room.
Gives you hot water but does not heat the room.
Keeps the house a little warm when nobody is home.
The boiler turns on by itself at set times.
Shows how warm the room is right now.
Each press makes the temperature you want 1 degree lower.
Appears when the boiler has a problem.

steps.en: wait, then check the room temperature

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: 외출 does not turn the boiler off. It keeps the house a little warm so the pipes do not freeze.

exercises: Look at the screen and answer in English: 난방 ● 예약 ○ 외출 ○ / 실내 온도 19℃ / 희망 온도 25℃ ① What is the room temperature now? ② What temperature does the user want?
Choose the right button (외출, ▼, 예약): ① 내일부터 일주일 동안 부산에 가요. 집에 아무도 없어요. ② 방이 너무 더워요. 25도에서 22도로 해요. ③ 보일러가 혼자 켜지면 좋겠어요.
Fill in the blank with a word from the button list: ① 날씨가 더워요. 따뜻한 물만 필요해요. ____ 버튼을 누르세요. ② 화면이 까매요. 아무것도 안 보여요. ____ 버튼을 누르세요. ③ 바닥이 차가워요. ____을 켜세요.
Look at the screen and write O (true) or X (false): 외출 ● / 실내 온도 16℃ ① 지금 외출 모드예요. ② 실내 온도는 16도예요. ③ 외출을 누르면 보일러가 꺼져요.
Read the screen and answer in English: 점검 E-03 What does this screen tell you, and who can you call?
answers: ① 온수 ② 전원 ③ 난방
① O ② O ③ X (The boiler stays on and keeps the house a little warm.)
The boiler has a problem and needs a check. Call the management office (관리실).
